meta.name: using-superpowers
meta.description: Use when starting any conversation - establishes how to find and use skills, requiring skill invocation before ANY response including clarifying questions

copy.tagline: 学会在对话中调用技能来完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你刚接触技能系统，需要了解如何调用技能。
copy.tagline_en: Learn to invoke skills in conversations to complete tasks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are new to the skill system and need to learn how to invoke skills.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 在每次回应前必须先检查并调用相关技能，包括提问、探索代码库等任何操作之前。它会宣布正在使用哪个技能，并严格遵循技能指令。
howto.when: 每次对话开始时，或当用户提出任何任务（包括简单问题）时触发。

say.text: 帮我写一个 Python 脚本。
say.note: Claude 会先检查是否有相关技能，然后调用技能执行。
Claude 会先检查技能，再给出解释。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude must check and invoke relevant skills before any response or action, including asking clarifying questions or exploring code. It announces which skill it is using and follows the skill exactly.
howto.when_en: Triggered at the start of any conversation or when the user presents any task, including simple questions.

say_en.text: Write a Python script for me.
say_en.note: Claude will first check for relevant skills, then invoke the skill to execute.
Claude will check skills first, then provide an explanation.
